tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Fixed 20-case recall benchmark (query->expected key or refusal) with the two live-verified cases verbatim; runner reports every rate with its denominator; unanswered never counts correct; scheduled run exits non-zero on misses; no product query-behavior changes; ch:trace row=DF-2026-17.: All sub-parts verified in commit 98b33bd8 (4 files: scripts/recall-benchmark/cases.json, scripts/recall-benchmark/run.mjs, .github/workflows/recall-benchmark.yml, tests/recall-benchmark.int.test.ts). (1) Fixed 20-case fixture: cases.json has exactly 20 cases (ids 1-20), 15 expectKeys + 5 expectRefusal, each exactly one expectation form (enforced by loadFixture run.mjs:158-166); 24 seeds, all expected keys planted, queries unique. (2) Live-verified cases verbatim: case 1 query 'cooldown' expectKeys [/sync/coding-hermes/last-success] and case 2 'zzzznothinglikethis' expectRefusal, both with observed='2026-10-27' and notes quoting the 2026-10-27 live API observations; test asserts them verbatim (tests/recall-benchmark.int.test.ts:75-82). (3) Runner reports every rate with its denominator: summarize() emits numerator+denominator for casePassRate, keyRecallMacro, keyRecallMicro, precisionMicro, correctRefusalRate, unansweredRate (run.mjs:517-529); printReport prints 'rates (numerator/denominator):' with N/D per rate (run.mjs:563-571); test asserts denominator 20/15/5/20 (test:104-113). (4) Unanswered never counts correct: scoreCase marks errored cases unanswered+MISS and empty-result keys cases unanswered (run.mjs:438-472); test asserts every unanswered result has verdict MISS (test:114-117); report even prints 'unanswered cases count as unanswered, never as correct' (run.mjs:572). (5) Scheduled run exits non-zero on misses: exitCode=0 (PASS) or 1 (FAIL) when missed>0, 2 only for infrastructure (run.mjs:652-656); workflow recall-benchmark.yml has cron '23 3 * * *' + workflow_dispatch and runs the runner (non-zero exits fail the step); negative-control test corrupts an expected key and asserts exit 1 + verdict FAIL (test:155-181). (6) No product query-behavior changes: commit touches only the workflow, bench scripts, and test — zero files under src/ or plugins/, ci.yml untouched; workflow comment 'Measurement-only: this workflow never changes product query behavior'; scratch daemon is hermetic (env scrubbed, provider=none). (7) ch:trace row=DF-2026-17 present in commit-message trailer of 98b33bd8 (line 52: 'ch:trace row=DF-2026-17 spec=scripts/recall-benchmark test=tests/recall-benchmark.int.test.ts::20-case-run+miss-negative-control evidence=/tmp/df2026-17-bench.txt witness=none:scratch-instance commit=THIS'), matching doctrine placement #3. Tests (actual command output): 'npx vitest run' via .gitreins/config.yaml guard → exit 0, 'Test Files 242 passed (242), Tests 2027 passed (2027)' (/tmp/unit-test.log); integration suite 'pnpm test:integration' (config includes tests/**/*.int.test.ts = exactly the 13 files run) → 'Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 84 passed (84)' (/tmp/bench-test.log, 129.30s), which includes the recall-benchmark fixture/runner/negative-control tests.
DF-2026-17 is complete: the fixed 20-case recall fixture (with the two live-verified cases verbatim), the denominator-reporting runner with unanswered-never-correct semantics and non-zero exit on misses, the nightly scheduled workflow, no product-query changes, and the ch:trace row=DF-2026-17 marker all verified via code inspection plus live runs of both the unit suite (242/242, 2027/2027) and the integration suite (13/13, 84/84).
